claims: NHL playoff overtime consists of 20-minute 5-on-5 sudden-death periods
NHL playoff overtime periods are repeated until a winner is decided
There are no shootouts in NHL playoff overtime unlike the regular season
There is no 3-on-3 play in NHL playoff overtime unlike the regular season
Intermissions between NHL playoff overtime periods are 15 minutes
The ice is resurfaced during intermissions between NHL playoff overtime periods
All NHL playoff overtime goals are reviewed by officials
In NHL playoff overtime, the first team to score wins
If a NHL playoff overtime period ends without a goal, another 20-minute period is played
Penalties carry over from regulation and between NHL playoff overtime periods
In NHL playoff overtime, 3-on-3 or 4-on-4 may occur if penalties are served
The default in NHL playoff overtime is 5-on-5
